what: Quest Diagnostics runs clinical laboratories across the United States. It processes blood and other samples ordered by doctors, hospitals and employers, and operates thousands of patient collection sites.
customers: Doctors and health systems ordering tests, insurers and patients paying for them, employers running workforce testing.
money: routine, advanced and specialty clinical testing
moat: A national laboratory and collection network with insurer contracts, where scale makes its cost per test lower than hospital or regional laboratories.
risks: Government reimbursement for routine tests is under continual pressure
Net margin of about 9% is thin
Debt of about $6 billion against under $1 billion of cash
Analyst targets imply the shares are roughly fairly valued
opportunities: Hospitals outsourcing laboratory work to it adds volume without new facilities
Advanced testing in oncology, neurology and women's health earns far more per test
watch: Organic volume growth and revenue per requisition.
